name: Charleston

neighborhoods.name: East End
neighborhoods.homes: older houses and small apartment buildings near the Capitol

housing: Charleston's rentals are mostly older houses and small apartment buildings, many on hillsides or along the rivers.

localRules.text: Owners must register every residential rental unit in the City of Charleston and get a rental license.

climate: Check the basement and yard drainage for water and test the heating; the Kanawha and Elk rivers flood and winters are cold.
fact: Many East End rentals are in older houses within walking distance of the West Virginia State Capitol.
